what: Ambient firmware: lofi chords, nature scenes and generative pads and bells, each with its own pixel picture. Play and the music follows: notes loop in an eight layer looper, each layer in its own voice. Build any chord progression or play whole chords live, program your own drums and a bass line that follows the chords, and let scenes slowly evolve. Thirteen reverb and delay spaces, a tape FILM knob and a sleep timer.
author: Theo Wecker
